    def test_assess_paging(self, non_admin_logged_in_page: Page, forward_console_and_page_errors_non_admin: None):
        """Test paging in the assess tab."""
        page = non_admin_logged_in_page
        self.navigate_to_assess(page)

        # Check that the paging controls are visible
        expect(page.get_by_role("link", name="Next")).to_be_visible()
        expect(page.get_by_role("link", name="Previous")).to_be_visible()
        expect(page.get_by_label("Rows per page")).to_be_visible()

        # Get the initial number of stories per page (should be 20 as per ASSESS_STORY_PAGE_SIZE)
        initial_stories = page.locator('[data-test-id^="story-card-"]')
        expect(initial_stories).to_have_count(ASSESS_STORY_PAGE_SIZE)

        # Change rows per page to 5
        page.get_by_label("Rows per page").select_option("5")
        # Wait for the table to update
        expect(page.locator('[data-test-id^="story-card-"]')).to_have_count(5)

        # Go to next page
        page.get_by_role("link", name="Next").click()
        # Wait for the table to update
        expect(page.locator('[data-test-id^="story-card-"]')).to_have_count(5)
